Position Overview
We are seeking a Full-Stack & Platform SW Engineer to build developer productivity tools, modern web interfaces, and containerized deployment infrastructure. You will be responsible for building developer-friendly CLI/TUI tools, maintaining web applications, and packaging platform services for enterprise on-premise deployments.
Responsibilities & Opportunities
Develop and maintain developer platform tools, including Python-based CLI/TUI interfaces and web dashboards.
Containerize multi-tier web and backend applications using
Docker
and
Helm
for enterprise on-premise customer deployments.
Maintain and enhance company web applications and developer-facing web properties.
Integrate execution adapters for compute cluster job managers (e.g., SLURM, SSH execution backends).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for software packaging and release distribution

Required Qualifications
BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in
Python
(CLI frameworks) and modern frontend web stacks (
React, TypeScript
).
Hands-on experience with
Docker
, containerization, and Linux system administration.
Experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and working with relational databases.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Helm/Kubernetes and packaging software for on-premise customer environments.
Familiarity with HPC job schedulers (SLURM, LSF) or developer productivity platforms.
Experience with Python TUI/CLI libraries (e.g., Rich, Textual, Click, Typer).
